purpose: Measure the effect of the rejection-path tests added for the coverage gap on the src/core/conservation.py mutation baseline. Coverage gap measurement only; production code is unchanged and no live defect is implied.
baseline_note: This re-run does not refresh the baseline. The baseline still goes stale on 2026-10-30 (30 days from 2026-09-29) or when the target sha256 changes.
report_visibility: The core-RPG report's mutation layer reads only tests/mutation/baselines/*.json, so this re-run record is invisible to it.

source.note: HEAD of the working tree; the two new test files were untracked at measurement time. src/ is unchanged versus origin/main.

tool.name: mutmut
tool.install: pip --target in a private scratch directory (not a project dependency, shared venv untouched); each pass ran from a scratch copy of the tree outside the repo, with a cleared mutmut cache
tool.why_not_3x: mutmut 3.x trampoline rejects modules whose import path starts with 'src.'

passes.name: pass_1_positive_control
passes.purpose: Baseline selection only (the unchanged 8 files); must reproduce the baseline counts before any delta is reported.
passes.command: mutmut run --paths-to-mutate src/core/conservation.py --runner "python -m pytest -x -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/integration/domains/adventure/test_harvest_to_event.py tests/integration/pipeline/test_transaction_completion.py tests/unit/combat/test_combat_matrix.py tests/unit/content/test_resolvers.py tests/unit/domains/adventure/test_craft_upgrade_execution.py tests/unit/economy/test_gold_sink.py tests/unit/quest/test_quest_rewards.py tests/unit/resource/test_durability_repair.py" --no-progress

passes.name: pass_2_delta
passes.purpose: Baseline selection plus the two new test files.
passes.command: mutmut run --paths-to-mutate src/core/conservation.py --runner "python -m pytest -x -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/integration/domains/adventure/test_harvest_to_event.py tests/integration/pipeline/test_transaction_completion.py tests/unit/combat/test_combat_matrix.py tests/unit/content/test_resolvers.py tests/unit/domains/adventure/test_craft_upgrade_execution.py tests/unit/economy/test_gold_sink.py tests/unit/quest/test_quest_rewards.py tests/unit/resource/test_durability_repair.py tests/unit/resource/test_conservation_rejection_paths.py tests/unit/resource/test_rejected_transfer_apply_path.py" --no-progress

before_after_test_set_note: Pass 2 adds tests/unit/resource/test_conservation_rejection_paths.py and tests/unit/resource/test_rejected_transfer_apply_path.py to the 8 baseline files. The delta is attributable to those two files only.

source_lines_82_91_exclusion.rule: Mutants on src/core/conservation.py source lines 82-91 were killed by tests/unit/resource/test_node_charge_accounting.py (outside the baseline selection and outside this selection); they are neither credited to this change nor re-counted as survivors of it.

flag_flip_survivors.description: The 22 accepted=False to accepted=True flip mutants that survived in the baseline. Ids are mutmut 2.5.1 mutant ids; 'source_line' is the 1-based line of src/core/conservation.py.
flag_flip_survivors.id_vs_line_note: Mutant ids 82, 86 and 91 are ids, not source lines: they sit on source lines 139, 144 and 158 (CRAFTING and SHOP_BUY), outside the lines 82-91 exclusion, and are credited to this change. None of the 22 flip mutants lies on source lines 82-91.

observations.reservation_condition_mutants: Survivors on source lines 104-126 (reservation and source-lookup conditions) fell from 16 to 0 as a side effect; this is an observation, not a requirement.
observations.existing_coverage_note: These three assert ReasonCode.TARGET_LOCKED through the apply path with two actors. They are deliberately not in either mutmut selection, so a surviving mutant in the baseline selection does not mean the behaviour was untested.
observations.building_reservation: resolve() has no reservation guard for buildings; no building lock test exists and no src/ guard was added.
observations.quest_recruit_chest_reservations: QUEST, RECRUIT and CHEST locks are reachable only by a direct resolve() call; the apply path populates reservations only for NODE, GROUND_ITEM and CORPSE.
